role: Contributor-original abstract acceptance descriptions; not executable fixtures or implemented features; MPL-2.0
assembly_rule: The future harness supplies original synthetic bytes, verified digests, valid identities and authorized stage contexts. Inputs are abstract message/stream descriptions unless marked raw_fragment or header_hex. Raw fragments intentionally bypass normal JSON construction. Success uses code null; every non-null code, transport_code and service_code is defined by F05 section 9 or F04 section 8. Each independent variation is a separate future test. Descriptions do not assert checks have run.

cases.description: CLI and native host negotiate the identical private-pipe profile.
given: Verified packaged worker; inherited private pipes only

input.abstract: Complete hello/capabilities/ready/ready_ack with protocol and model contract 0.1.0, matching nonce, runtime manifest, schema digest and required features.

cases.description: Arbitrary stream splits preserve one bounded control message.
given: Ready session; authorized OpenStage request

input.abstract: Split every header and UTF-8 payload at each possible byte boundary; supply exactly the declared bytes within assembly deadline.

cases.description: A fully verified attachment is delivered as opaque bytes.
given: Ready session; valid authorized change batch; future harness binds actual synthetic bytes and their computed SHA-256

input.abstract: One control descriptor and one binary attachment; u8 type, matching index, lengths, count and actual digest; bundle within all caps.

cases.description: Read a bounded revision-stamped snapshot page.
given: OpenStage recovered a verified complete workspace

input.abstract: ReadSnapshot with current nonce and full matching context; continue on the same pinned context with a valid cursor.

cases.description: Canonical replay ignores transport changes and equivalent number spellings.
given: Authorized actor; identical op_id already accepted and journaled; generation has since advanced

input.abstract: Retry F04 envelope with reordered keys, equivalent escaped strings, 1.0 instead of 1e0 and -0 instead of 0; change request_id, nonce, deadline and worker stage token.

cases.description: A valid new mutation accepts exactly once after host coordination.
given: Authorized fresh F04 command; matching context; complete bounded composition batch

input.abstract: Validate full bundle, stage isolated candidate, validate composition and complete host serialized acceptance and outcome recording.

cases.description: Cancellation before the decision point proves discard.
given: One pending mutation; isolated candidate only; no apply/commit decision

input.abstract: Host sends sole cancel targeting pending request; worker proves pre-commit discard.

cases.description: Cancellation after acceptance reports the recorded result.
given: Host has recorded an accepted mutation; terminal response not yet delivered

input.abstract: A cancel arrives after the apply/commit point; recorded acceptance is available.

cases.description: Crash recovery invalidates session state and preserves drafts.
given: Original workspace has verified unpublished edits; old child exit confirmed

input.abstract: Use one permitted restart, fresh nonce and OpenStage after U07 recovery; old tokens/cursors are discarded.

cases.description: Backpressure converts excess incremental changes to invalidation.
given: One queued changed event; another bounded change arrives before delivery

input.abstract: Coalesce to one resnapshot_required notification; client stops deltas and reads a bounded snapshot.

cases.description: Negotiation selects smaller supported limits.
given: All required features and runtime/schema identities match

input.abstract: Worker advertises a 524288-byte control cap; host supports 1048576; ready and ready_ack agree on 524288.

cases.description: Heartbeat does not substitute for a pending request result.
given: One normal request within its deadline

input.abstract: One increasing ping_id receives its matching pong within 15000 ms while normal request remains pending.

cases.description: Unsupported wire version has a diagnostic and terminates before payload parsing.
given: No stage opened

input.abstract: Recognized magic with major 99; do not interpret payload under local 0.1.0 rules.

cases.description: Oversized declared control payload fails before allocation.
given: No earlier pending mutation

input.abstract: Control payload length is 1048577 bytes, above the default cap.

cases.description: EOF inside a frame is truncation, never a partial request.
given: No dispatched mutation

input.abstract: Declare a 100-byte control payload, provide 50 bytes and close the pipe; repeat for each partial header boundary.

cases.description: Binary length disagreement rejects the entire bundle.
given: Complete control descriptor claims four bytes; no dispatch yet

input.abstract: Matching binary common header/prefix claim three data bytes rather than the descriptor's four.

cases.description: Invalid UTF-8 is rejected before JSON object construction.
given: No dispatched mutation

input.abstract: Place the byte sequence c3 28 in an otherwise framed JSON string.

cases.description: Duplicate decoded object keys cannot use last-value-wins parsing.
given: Otherwise valid request envelope

input.abstract: Also repeat with a key written once literally and once with an equivalent Unicode escape.

cases.description: Non-JSON NaN literal is rejected.
given: Otherwise valid F04 mutation

input.abstract: Insert fragment in logical_command.arguments; frame lengths remain consistent.

cases.description: Valid JSON numeric overflow is rejected without rounding into infinity.
given: Otherwise valid F04 mutation

cases.description: A binary frame without a preceding descriptor is fatal.
given: Ready session expecting a control bundle

input.abstract: Send a kind-2 frame when no attachment is declared, even with an internally valid prefix and digest.

cases.description: An attachment above its byte cap fails before allocation.
given: Ready session; no pending mutation

input.abstract: Declare one descriptor with byte_length and element_count 16777217, one above the default maximum.

cases.description: An unknown message type is never ignored.
given: Ready session; valid JSON and nonce

input.abstract: Send type 'future_execute' with an empty buffers array.

cases.description: A duplicate request_id does not reapply work.
given: Request ID 1 completed in this session

input.abstract: Send another request with ID 1, whether its F04 op_id is unchanged or new.

cases.description: A response for an unknown request_id cannot update the client.
given: Only ID 1 is pending

input.abstract: Worker responds to request_id 2.

cases.description: Post-commit cancel with unavailable outcome remains uncertain.
given: Mutation crossed apply/commit decision point; durable recorded result cannot yet be verified

input.abstract: Cancel targets that pending mutation after the decision point.

cases.description: Worker exit mid-mutation does not prove rollback.
given: A dispatched mutation may have crossed its decision point; host cannot verify whether outcome recording completed

input.abstract: Worker exits before a conclusive terminal result; pipes close between frames.

cases.description: A request deadline does not prove rollback.
given: Dispatched mutation; no recorded result and no proven pre-commit discard

input.abstract: timeout_ms expires; cancel grace of 1000 ms also expires; stop/reap child.

cases.description: New operations reject the wrong workspace base revision.
given: Authorized new op_id; matching nonce and stage token

input.abstract: context.base_revision and logical_command.base_revision agree with each other but differ from the selected workspace's pinned base.

cases.description: New operations reject a stale generation.
given: Authorized new op_id; matching nonce, stage token and base

input.abstract: context.workspace_generation and logical_command.expected_generation match each other but lag the workspace's recorded generation.

cases.description: A stage token from an earlier incarnation is stale.
given: Fresh handshake and verified recovery; new op_id

input.abstract: Use the old pre-restart stage token with current session nonce and otherwise matching revision/generation.

cases.description: Model data cannot inject plugin paths or scripts.
given: Ready worker; otherwise authorized local model

input.abstract: Synthetic model contains a directive requesting an unverified plugin search path or script execution; no real private path or script payload is supplied.

cases.description: Handshake capability mismatch never silently downgrades.
given: Host expects a verified schema digest and the required cancel feature

input.abstract: Capabilities supplies a different schema digest, unexpected runtime version or omits cancel; run each mismatch independently.

cases.description: Garbage magic or unsupported flags cause no resynchronization.
given: No pending mutation

input.abstract: Replace magic with zeros, or set flags to one; append a valid-looking later header.

cases.description: Wrong digest rejects correctly sized binary bytes.
given: Harness computes original synthetic descriptor and then flips one data byte

input.abstract: Lengths, indices and types match; streamed SHA-256 disagrees.

cases.description: Combined attachments may not exceed the bundle cap.
given: Each attachment separately fits 16 MiB

input.abstract: Declare two 16-MiB buffers plus headers and control; total exceeds 32 MiB.

cases.description: A second normal request is rejected while one is pending.
given: Read-only request ID 1 pending; no mutation uncertainty

input.abstract: Send a new increasing ID 2 request before response 1.

cases.description: Excess depth cannot force recursive object allocation.
given: Otherwise valid framed control

input.abstract: Add a seventeenth nested container; separately exceed a decoded string cap or token cap.

cases.description: Numeric strings do not satisfy engineering number fields.
given: Otherwise valid fresh F04 command

cases.description: Nonzero decimal underflow may not become zero.
given: Otherwise valid fresh F04 command

cases.description: An accepted op_id with changed canonical content is rejected.
given: Actor still authorized; accepted replay record exists

input.abstract: Reuse the F04 op_id but change one dimension; changing request_id does not bypass the ledger.

cases.description: Old-session messages cannot reach the new stage.
given: Fresh session nonce and ready stage

input.abstract: Send an otherwise valid request carrying the old nonce.

cases.description: An unresponsive read fails as backend unavailable.
given: Only a read-only request is pending; mutation uncertainty does not apply

input.abstract: Worker hangs past its deadline or fails to answer ping within 15000 ms.

cases.description: Trickled incomplete bundles cannot extend the assembly timer.
given: No complete request dispatched

input.abstract: Send bytes often enough to avoid an idle read but do not finish a declared bundle within 10000 ms from its first byte.

cases.description: Cancel cannot address an unrecognized request.
given: Only ID 2 pending; last completed ID 1

input.abstract: Send cancel with target_request_id 3.

cases.description: Retry exhaustion cannot become an unbounded restart loop.
given: Initial worker launch and two permitted automatic restarts fail during one open/recovery attempt

input.abstract: Supervisor considers a fourth automatic launch.

cases.description: A missing recovered outcome is not an assumed rejection.
given: Recovered worker is available; journal cannot prove acceptance or absence

input.abstract: QueryOutcome after one automatic recovery query for a dispatched mutation.

cases.description: Extra attachments and unsupported element types are not ignored.
given: Otherwise valid control bundle

input.abstract: Separately test descriptor count different from header, skipped index, non-u8 type or extra kind-2 frame after the declared count.

cases.description: ID counters rotate the session instead of wrapping.
given: Last permitted request/ping/event ID has been used and its outcome resolved

input.abstract: Attempt to emit an ID beyond 65535 or wrap to an earlier ID.
